item.title: Natchitoches Parish Port Warehouse advances in state’s FastSites Program
item.description: The Natchitoches Parish Port Warehouse is among 19 sites across 16 parishes selected for Louisiana Economic Development’s inaugural FastSites round, the largest coordinated site investment effort in state history.
